name: from_ptr
declaration: const unsafe fn from_ptr < 'a > (ptr : * mut * mut T) -> & 'a AtomicPtr < T >
rules: The pointer ptr must be aligned to the alignment of AtomicPtr<T>, which on some platforms can be greater than the alignment of *mut T.
The pointer ptr must be valid for reads for the whole lifetime 'a.
The pointer ptr must be valid for writes for the whole lifetime 'a.
The caller must adhere to the memory model for atomic accesses.
Atomic and non-atomic accesses must not be mixed without synchronization.
Atomic accesses of different sizes must not be mixed without synchronization.
